description: Frozen Bound Plan corpus. Every sourcePlan is real Call #1 output, or a minimally edited copy of real Call #1 output. Ground truth was established by manual reading of the source text and is the reference for binder correctness.

cases.dialect: ## Day N / ### Strength Block N / ### SUPERSET Block N / - **Sets:**
cases.acceptance: byte-identical geometryHash, Output 06 and Output 07 versus the legacy path

cases.dialect: # Day N / ### Strength / **SINGLE — X** / **SUPERSET A** / N. **exr_id — Name**
cases.truthSource: Recomputed from this exact file via the legacy Call #2 structure plus the adapter, and cross-checked against the 46 exr_ occurrences in the source. The figures in AI_CALL_3_DETERMINISTIC_REPLACEMENT_STUDY.md section 8 (47/59/12/152) describe a DIFFERENT, since-deleted Fixture B generation and must not be used for this file.
cases.acceptance: byte-identical Output 06 and Output 07, including the eight ambiguous SUPERSET block rests

cases.dialect: # Workout N / ### Block N — Strength / **SINGLE | exr_id — Name** / **SUPERSET A**
cases.notes: Call #2 correctly declined to bind the rhetorical '**SUPERSET B** / exr_tricep-less? / Not included intentionally' block. The run was killed by the open-regex global ID scan in buildCompactExerciseLookup, not by Call #2.
cases.acceptance: exr_tricep-less is never a closed-dictionary coverage candidate; workout_2 binds exactly 4 blocks

cases.dialect: ## Session N / ### Block N — TYPE / indented **sets:** without a leading dash
cases.notes: Legacy Output 04 matches ground truth exactly. The resolver's workout regex accepts only 'Day N' and 'Workout N', so it parsed zero workouts from '## Session N'. Purely a second-parser failure.
cases.acceptance: 11 blocks and 15 exercises bound; no dependence on heading vocabulary

cases.dialect: # Day N / ### Block A — freeform title / superset declared in prose as '- **Superset:** B1 with B2'
cases.notes: Legacy Output 04 reported 5 blocks per workout with TWO SUPERSET entries, splitting the single two-lane superset into one block per exercise. The geometry-only schema cannot express arity, so the adapter would have fabricated 2 lanes for each, yielding 7 exercises where the coach wrote 5. Under BoundPlan this is a BINDER failure caught by V4 (SUPERSET with one exercise) and is retryable.
cases.acceptance: the prose-declared superset binds as ONE SUPERSET block with two lanes; 8 blocks and 10 exercises total

cases.edit: Deleted the entire '# Day 2' section and its preceding separator.
cases.acceptance: two independent count-free binds both report 1 workout; violation concerns a constraint stated at programGenerationProfileNarrative.js:163, so creator repair becomes eligible; with repair unavailable the run fails closed as CREATOR_WORKOUT_COUNT_UNSATISFIED

cases.edit: Session 1 Block 3 lane B (exr_seated_cable_row) sets changed from 3 to 2.
cases.acceptance: D4 fail closed. Never pad 2 to 3. Violation concerns a constraint stated at programGenerationPrompt.js:166, so creator repair becomes eligible

cases.acceptance: span verification passes because the id IS present in the source; pool membership fails; violation concerns a constraint stated at programGenerationPrompt.js:154, so creator repair becomes eligible
